notes.title: [DEMO] Version 0.6.1 (2024.05.21)
notes.notes:
[h3]🌿 What’s new:[/h3]
– Updated default ability and ultimate icons.
– Guardians will no longer take excessive damage at once (maximum 10 damage at a time). The cooldown between damage instances is set to 0.5 seconds.
– Elemental energy will now move towards guardians when they are close to each other, making it easier to obtain.
– Added exclusive guardian "Engel" for players who purchased the pre-order ticket.
– Minor design changes. 


[h3]🌿 Bug fix:[/h3]
– Minor bug fixes.


[h3]🌿 This release includes:[/h3]
– 6+1 guardians (3+1 available for demo)
– 6+1 forest spells (4+1 available for demo)
– Campaign mode (10 stages)
– Survival mode (1 stage)



Your feedback is important to me, and I’m super excited to make improvements based on your input. Thank you so much! 🙂


You can read devlog and find out more about the game on the 🌐[url=https://diemn.com/gof]website[/url].

notes.title: [DEMO] Version 0.6.0 (2024.05.07)
notes.notes:
[h3]🌿 What’s new:[/h3]
– Campaign stages 2-1 to 2-5 have been added. These might be the final campaign stages available for the demo version.
– The key settings feature has been added. You can now freely change your key settings.
– Guardians’ basic attacks are now auto-fired, meaning you don’t have to keep pressing a basic attack key to fire bullets.
– Fire energy has been reworked. A guardian will now get a ring of fire that damages enemies on contact, instead of a damage buff.
– Air energy has been reworked. A guardian will now shoot air slashes that damage and halt enemies, instead of providing an attack speed buff.
– A new title screen has been added. You will see the new title screen randomly.
– Hohora’s name has been changed to “Hehero”. Please note that this change might result in a loss of Hohora’s gameplay data.
– Hohora’s ability has undergone a minor design update.
– Jade Earthworm has been redesigned.
– New enemies have been added – red runner, bigot, bullkiller, hunter and trespasser.


[h3]🌿 Bug fix:[/h3]
– Minor bug fixes.


[h3]🌿 This release includes:[/h3]
– 6+1 guardians (3 available for demo)
– 6+1 forest spells (4+1 available for demo)
– Campaign mode (10 stages)
– Survival mode (1 stage)



Your feedback is important to me, and I’m super excited to make improvements based on your input. Thank you so much! 🙂
